name: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd
about: The Company was established in 1981. A joint venture agreement was signed between the Government of India and Suzuki Motor Corporation (SMC), Japan in 1982.

guidance.extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.quote: The broad expectation , which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year.
items.actual: Up 26.5% year on year in Q2 FY27
items.why: Q2 total volumes grew 26.5% to a record 6.97 lakh units, well ahead of the expectation.
items.actual_quote: If we combine our domestic and export performance, the company achieved its highest ever quarterly total sales volume of 696,654 units, representing growth of 26.5% year -on-year.

items.promise: Back towards 10% within a quarter or two
items.quote: But once we have passed through the Middle East conflict and part of it getting reversed and we potentially taking some price increase as well, in a quarter or 2, we should get back on a trajectory of margin expansion and potentially in the direction of 10% EBIT margin, which we have targeted to reach by 2030.
items.actual: About 5.5% of net sales in Q2 FY27
items.why: Two quarters on, EBIT of Rs 28 billion on Rs 506 billion of sales is about 5.5%, below last year; it did rise 10.8% from Q1.
items.actual_quote: The Operating profit (EBIT), in this quarter stood at over INR 28 billion as compared to over INR 33.8 billion in Q2 financial year '25-'26, owing to the West Asia conflict-linked commodity increases.

bull.text: Management is delivering: 1 of 2 checkable promises kept or on track
Revenue has compounded 21.1% a year over 5 years
Profit grew faster than sales (27.3% vs 21.1% a year), so margins widened

bear.text: Growth is slowing: revenue 15.7% a year over 3 years vs 21.1% over 5

claims.summary: The prepared remarks on the latest calls had no whole-company figures to check; management spoke in segment numbers.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 122% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 11 days to pay, against 10 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 24% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. A meaningful slice of profit does not come from the core business.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 1% while operating profit grew 6%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 23%, against 23% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.00× equity, against 0.00× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 58.7%, up 0.4 points over the last 4 reported quarters.

quality.summary: 7 of 8 checks are clean; look at: profit comes from the core business.
